ask: Share durable project context across Code, Chat, and Cowork sessions.
plugin: An MCP memory store indexes project notes; a skill reads and updates them at session boundaries.

ask: Apply personal instructions and skills to cloud and mobile Code sessions.
plugin: A command packages user instructions and skills for cloud session setup, with a hook checking the loaded context.

ask: Move task context and work between Code, Cowork, browser, and remote sessions.
plugin: An MCP ledger stores task state and artifacts; commands resume it on the destination surface.

ask: Run delayed, recurring, and bounded follow-up tasks with useful status and feedback.
plugin: A monitor schedules plugin commands and an MCP server records run status and delivers follow-ups.

ask: Make connector and MCP tools available to unattended scheduled runs.
plugin: A plugin MCP gateway starts required servers and reports missing tools before each job.

ask: Keep skill files and working folders available to scheduled jobs.
plugin: A command snapshots selected skills and paths into a durable bundle; a start hook verifies access.

ask: Apply budgets, dry runs, and supervision to long-running tasks.
plugin: Settings hooks gate risky tools and cap time or token use; a monitor stops runaway jobs.

ask: Preserve transcripts and outputs when clients update, crash, archive, or compact.
plugin: A monitor copies JSONL and artifacts to versioned storage; commands search and restore copies.

ask: Find sessions by prompt, project, ID, and recent activity.
plugin: A bin indexer reads session metadata and transcripts and provides a searchable command.

ask: Archive, close, rename, and clean up sessions from the terminal.
plugin: Commands wrap supported session operations and maintain a local alias and archive index.

ask: See running agents by project with stable sorting, grouping, and state.
plugin: A bin dashboard reads session and worktree state and displays filtered rows and task metadata.

ask: See context, model, effort, and usage for every active agent.
plugin: A statusline and monitor combine session usage and agent metadata into per-agent metrics and alerts.

ask: Send messages to running agents and coordinate peers.
plugin: An MCP queue identifies sessions and delivers messages; a skill sets receipt conventions.

ask: Attach to or resume background sessions by stable ID.
plugin: A bin command resolves session aliases and invokes supported attach or resume operations.

ask: Select models and effort per agent or scheduled task without changing global defaults.
plugin: A function hook sets model and effort at agent.spawn or turn.step from per-agent rules.

ask: Keep long sessions useful through controlled compaction and handoff summaries.
plugin: A function hook rewrites compaction output and stores continuity summaries; a command starts linked sessions.

ask: Apply consistent permission decisions and clear approval routing.
plugin: Settings hooks enforce allow and deny rules, log decisions, and route pending approvals to a monitor.

ask: Require explicit device pairing before browser tools touch a remote browser.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook checks browser identity and blocks calls without a matching approval token.

ask: Provide browser automation when the built-in Chrome bridge is unavailable.
plugin: A standalone MCP browser server exposes navigation, screenshots, tabs, and file upload over a user-controlled browser connection.

ask: Manage browser site allow and block patterns.
plugin: An MCP browser gateway applies configured domain rules before navigation and logs decisions.

ask: Keep a searchable history of browser actions and captured pages.
plugin: A tool hook records browser calls and results with page links and screenshots.

ask: Use GitLab, Azure DevOps, and public GitHub repositories in workflows.
plugin: An MCP server implements repository listing, issues, PRs, and git operations; a skill routes work to it.

ask: Detect missing, disconnected, or misconfigured MCP tools before work starts.
plugin: A monitor probes configured servers and schemas, surfaces status, and retries supported restarts.

ask: Reach remote MCP servers and manage separate connector instances.
plugin: An MCP proxy normalizes server names and routes each instance to its own credentials.

ask: Run long MCP tasks without losing results to client timeouts.
plugin: An MCP wrapper starts work asynchronously, returns a job ID, and exposes progress and result polling.

ask: Protect dirty worktrees and make branch changes deliberate.
plugin: A settings hook checks git status before worktree or push operations; commands manage checkout and cleanup.

ask: Honor user branch names and prevent unwanted commits, pushes, or PR actions.
plugin: PreToolUse hooks block disallowed git operations; a skill applies configured branch and PR rules.

ask: Notify on meaningful CI changes and react to merge conflicts or review events.
plugin: A monitor follows PR checks, deduplicates notices, and invokes configured repair commands.

ask: Browse and preview project files from a session.
plugin: An MCP file server lists and previews files; a command opens paths in the configured editor.

ask: Open a project in the preferred editor or external browser.
plugin: A command resolves project and worktree paths and launches the configured editor or preview URL.

ask: Choose and remember working directories for new sessions and scheduled jobs.
plugin: A command maintains named roots and starts Claude in the selected root, including monorepo subfolders.

ask: Start remote sessions through configured SSH binaries and aliases.
plugin: A bin launcher resolves SSH config and runs Claude remotely with a durable session reference.

ask: Supply secrets and environment variables safely to session tools.
plugin: A settings hook fetches scoped secrets from a local provider and injects them into approved tool calls.

ask: Export session and tool events to OpenTelemetry or a local event store.
plugin: Hooks record lifecycle events; a monitor emits OTLP records with configured privacy controls.

ask: Notify when tasks finish, need input, or change state.
plugin: Lifecycle hooks send notifications keyed by session and event so repeats can be deduplicated.

ask: Read complete transcripts with timestamps and hidden tool output.
plugin: A command renders stored JSONL, supports search, and opens cited tool results.

ask: Generate session titles in a selected language.
plugin: A Stop hook summarizes the turn and applies a localized title through available session APIs.

ask: Adjust answer formatting, markdown styling, and coaching hints.
plugin: An output style and function UI hook change rendered presentation or suppress selected hints.

ask: Customize submit, newline, focus, and navigation keys.
plugin: A function UI hook remaps input and press events from user-configured bindings.

ask: Dictate prompts or converse with Code sessions.
plugin: An audio-capable MCP or bin command transcribes speech and submits it as session text.

ask: Display stable project, branch, host, and agent identity.
plugin: A statusline or function UI hook reads session and git metadata and renders concise labels.

ask: Track work assignments and completion across many agents.
plugin: An MCP task board stores tasks and IDs; a skill enforces assignment and reporting.

ask: Detect malformed or incomplete tool output before the model acts.
plugin: A tool.call function hook validates result schemas, expands truncated data, and flags unverified claims.

ask: Detect stuck background jobs and orphaned agent processes.
plugin: A monitor compares process liveness, session status, and task progress and requests controlled shutdown.

ask: Create drafts with attachments, reply in threads, mark messages read, and use multiple accounts.
plugin: An MCP Gmail server exposes typed mail tools with a separate OAuth credential for each account.

ask: Send email and perform authorized Microsoft 365 write actions.
plugin: An MCP Microsoft Graph server exposes scoped write tools with explicit confirmation hooks.

ask: Set event colors when creating and updating calendar events.
plugin: An MCP calendar server exposes colorId in its create and update tool schemas.

ask: Inspect Sentry projects and issues from Code sessions.
plugin: An MCP Sentry server provides authenticated issue, project, and event tools.

ask: Prepare cloud coding environments with the tools and runtimes a project needs.
plugin: A command generates idempotent setup scripts from project configuration and checks versions at session start.

ask: Review an agent plan before implementation and record actionable changes.
plugin: A specialist agent checks scope, evidence, risks, and acceptance criteria and writes a review artifact.

ask: Supervise many active agents through one conversational coordinator.
plugin: A specialist agent uses an MCP session registry and task board to inspect progress and send instructions.

ask: Offer programmable session restart, stop, and hot loading of tools.
plugin: A function hook registers commands and handles session lifecycle and tool availability transitions.

ask: Pass user-assigned browser names accurately to the model.
plugin: A tool.call hook annotates browser tool results with the configured human-readable browser name.
